text:
QUOTE: "reached a transfer accuracy of 0.95" METRIC: transfer_acc ISSUE: Transfer accuracy is 0.79; 0.95 is the strong model's ceiling.
QUOTE: "The margin over the baseline exceeds twice the reported standard error of the PGR" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: The 0.43 margin is ~4.3x the SE of 0.1, but more importantly the claim as stated is a significance assertion resting on a single-condition SE with 4 seeds.
